report.scene_summary: The video shows a manufacturing floor with large industrial machinery (presses) on the left and a marked pedestrian aisle on the right. Workers are observed moving within the machine zone and walking along the aisle. A metal coil is stored on the floor near the machinery, and a pallet of materials is placed in the aisle. The scene is generally well-lit, though some areas near the machinery are cluttered.

findings.title: Obstruction of marked aisle by stored materials
findings.location: Aisle area, right side of the scene
findings.observation: A pallet loaded with materials is positioned on the floor such that it encroaches upon the marked pedestrian aisle (green painted path with yellow borders). The pallet is stationary in the sampled frames.
findings.risk_interpretation: The obstruction narrows the clear width of the marked aisle, potentially creating a trip hazard or forcing pedestrians to step into the machine zone to pass.
findings.applicability_reason: The pallet is a stationary object physically obstructing a marked aisle and walking-working surface.
unknowns: Whether the marked path is an official exit route
Whether the obstruction is intended or temporary
recommended_actions: Relocate the pallet to a designated storage area outside the marked aisle boundaries.
Ensure all aisles remain clear of stored materials to maintain safe clearance.

findings.title: Worker proximity to machinery
findings.location: Machine zone, left side of the scene
findings.observation: A worker is observed standing inside the yellow safety railing, in close proximity to the point of operation of a press machine. The machine's operational state (running vs. stopped) is not definitively clear from the still frames.
findings.risk_interpretation: If the machine is operating or if energy is not controlled, the worker is exposed to crushing or entanglement hazards. If the machine is off for maintenance, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures may be required.
findings.applicability_reason: The worker is in the danger zone of a mechanical power press. The hazard depends on the machine's energy state and guarding status.
recommended_actions: Verify if the machine is operating; if so, ensure point-of-operation guards are in place.
If the worker is servicing the machine, confirm that Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures are being followed.
Ensure the worker is wearing appropriate PPE (e.g., safety glasses) given the proximity to machinery.

zone_reviews.interpretation: Pedestrian aisle with a pallet of materials obstructing the marked path.

Storage area along the wall with containers and bins; no obstruction of the main path.

Close-up of a machine control panel and side; no immediate hazard visible.
Close-up of a machine component (gear/motor); appears covered.

dismissed.reason: The machine's operational state cannot be confirmed from still frames; activity is inferred but not proven.
No visible lock/tag does not prove absence of isolation; energy state is unknown.
Worker's eye protection is not clearly visible or readable in the provided crops.

limitations: No reliable floor-like mask found; static-zone ranking uses general scene candidates.
Machine operational status and energy isolation status are unknown.
PPE compliance cannot be fully verified due to image resolution and angle.
